title: Startale Earn (Soneium): live 3-hourly JIT yield capture from the distributor remainder — $92/day per $1M, $322/day at $3.5M PoC, ~$333/day at the full USDSC float
categories_note: E-U is a per-day income stream, not a stock: $322.43/day at $3.5M capital, $117,686/yr annualised; $92.12/day per $1M. The leak is paid by Startale's toStartaleExtra remainder, not by depositors.
open_reasons: Deployed EarnVaultV1 has no deposit cap, minimum, whitelist, lock, withdrawal delay, fee or deposit-age check; runtime codehash 0x49971fba...41fa83 matches the verified source and has not changed since Nov 2025.
The 30 bp fee and snapshotMaxAge=300s are unchanged; neither is a defence against the vault-internal accrual (onYield credits live totalPrincipal).

Neither contract is paused; no blacklist or pause event has ever been emitted. The owner/pauser SafeL2 can only react post-hoc, and pause does not stop onYield accrual; a fresh address bypasses blacklisting.

No competing JIT bot exists: 0 deposits in the pre-snapshot 10-block window and 0 in the snapshot->distribute window across 22 fresh epochs (120k blocks), plus only 16 incidental $10-21 window deposits in the full 1,312-epoch lifetime census.
flashloan_binding_constraint: snapshotVaultTVLs() and distribute() are onlyRole(OPERATOR_ROLE) on the RewardRedistributor; sole member is keeper EOA 0x86bE13a26d548FA5407Ee3E5a8321B4E1019333C; EarnVault.onYield is onlyYieldRedistributor (RR). A single-tx flashloan->deposit->snapshot->distribute->withdraw->repay reverts at snapshotVaultTVLs() with AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(attacker, 0x97667070...). Additionally MustSnapshotInPreviousBlocks forces the keeper snapshot into a prior block; live keeper gap is 2 blocks / 4 s in 21/22 epochs.

flashloan_sources.aave_v3_soneium: no USDSC reserve (WETH/USDC.e/USDT; market being deprecated)
flashloan_sources.morpho_soneium: no USDSC market found; ~$30.7k total Soneium TVL
flashloan_sources.multi_block_flash: none trustless; any substitute is a collateralized loan requiring upfront collateral

minimal_capital_no_flashloan.note: No protocol minimum (deposit rejects only 0); any non-zero amount captures pro-rata. The capital must be held across the 2-block/4-s keeper gap; own/collateralized USDSC is required.

poc.method: Foundry 1.8.5 anvil fork of Soneium mainnet at blocks 29,573,086 (small epoch) and 29,568,020 (large epoch); real keeper snapshotVaultTVLs() -> distribute() -> attacker withdraw(); real pending M0 yield; plus a 7-test flashloan suite at 29,573,086 with a real Uniswap v4 $1M/$2M flash loan and the atomic-cycle revert. No mainnet txs.
poc.note: The small-epoch fork (pending minted $34.461987, toEarn $6.503126) was followed 11 minutes later by the real mainnet epoch at block 29,573,429: minted $34.462, toEarn $6.5031, toStartaleExtra $27.7765 — exact match.

Live at block 29,573,641 (2026-10-18T00:07:13Z): totalPrincipal $848,044.621512, claimReserve $850,841.582979, vault balance $852,359.908674, USDSC supply $4,480,591.955252, attackable float $3,618,232.93, fee 30bp, snapshotMaxAge 300s, not paused.

Schedule: snapshotVaultTVLs() nominally at HH:00:05, distribute() nominally at HH:00:09 every 3h; across 22 fresh epochs all snapshots were :05-:19 and all distributions :09-:27, with 21/22 gaps of 2 blocks / 4s (one 5-block / 10s). The 00:00:09Z 2026-10-18 epoch minted $34.462, toEarn $6.5031, toStartaleExtra $27.7765.

Mechanism: snapshot records lastEarnTVL = totalPrincipal (H); distribute sizes toEarn = net*T_earn/S_base from that snapshot, then EarnVault.onYield credits globalIndex += toEarn*RAY/totalPrincipal_LIVE (no vault snapshot). Deposit X before the snapshot -> T_earn = H+X -> attacker share = net*X/S_base; honest share unchanged.

Play-P fork PoC (7/7 tests): X=$1M small epoch captured $7.668376 (toEarn $14.171502, honest $6.503125, Startale extra $20.108106 vs $27.7765 control); X=$1M large epoch captured $15.362088 (toEarn $28.388284, honest $13.026195).
X=$3.5M: small epoch capture $26.839317 (toEarn $33.342443, Startale extra $0.937165); large epoch capture $53.767310 (toEarn $66.793506, Startale extra $1.877908).

Measured run-rate 4 small + 4 large epochs/day: $92.121856/day per $1M ($33,624/yr); $322.426504/day at $3.5M ($117,686/yr); extrapolated $333.31/day at the full $3,618,232.93 float. Gross return on dedicated capital ~3.2-3.4%/yr across windows (3.36% on the measured pair).

Costs: 152,574 gas deposit + 144,559 gas withdraw = 297,133 gas; at 2.3e6 wei/gas plus measured L1 data fee 4.12e9 wei/tx, ~$0.0017/epoch, ~$0.013/day, ~$4.8/yr. Two attacker txs per epoch (+ one-time max approval or depositWithPermit).

12-epoch fresh mean (2026-10-16 15:00 -> 2026-10-18 00:00 UTC): minted $51.1882, toEarn $9.6838, toOn $0.1173, toStartaleExtra $41.2335; minted alternates $32.64-$69.14, consistent with a multi-epoch M0 index-update cadence.

Attacker capital is available: UniV4 PoolManager holds $2,252,985.60 USDSC, a Safe $500,339.67, EOAs $219,656.85/$162,476.01, UniV3 pool $134,884.61. No USDSC lending market found; the snapshot->distribute gap spans blocks, so a single-tx flash loan cannot be used.

Honest depositors are not harmed: their share of toEarn is identical in control vs attack (P1 small $6.503125 vs $6.503126; large $13.026195 vs $13.0262). The entire capture comes from Startale's toStartaleExtra remainder bucket.

Monitor analysis/monitor.py in the final CI run at block 29,574,519 (2026-10-18T00:36Z): impl 0x7dca..., not paused, fee 30, maxAge 300, owner/pauser unchanged, 3 snapshots / 3 distributions, 7 deposits, 0 window deposits, status OK.

Flashloan gate (block 29,599,442, 2026-10-18 ~14:26Z): snapshotVaultTVLs() and distribute() revert for a random EOA with AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(0x...dEaD, OPERATOR_ROLE=0x97667070...); getRoleMemberCount(OPERATOR_ROLE)=1, sole member keeper 0x86bE...333C; onYield reverts NotYieldRedistributor for non-RR callers. Impl still 0x7dCA..., not paused, fee 30, maxAge 300.

v4 flashloan reality: Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x360E68faCcca8cA495c1B759Fd9EEe466db9FB32 held $2,252,926.68 USDSC at the fork and $2,252,349.52 at the latest recheck; fork tests borrowed $1M and $2M in one tx and repaid with zero protocol fee (87,965 gas round trip). The full atomic JIT cycle nevertheless reverts at snapshotVaultTVLs() and rolls back the loan+deposit.

Other USDSC same-tx liquidity: UniV3 USDSC/USDC.e 0.01% 0x680bf... holds $134,894.81 (1 bp fee); UniV3 0.30% 0x6Dad... holds $125,101 (30 bp). Aave v3 Soneium has no USDSC reserve (WETH/USDC.e/USDT; market being deprecated); Morpho Soneium has no USDSC market (~$30.7k total TVL). Only v4 provides $1M+ same-tx depth.

Timing guard: MustSnapshotInPreviousBlocks makes same-block snapshot+distribute revert even for the keeper; the live keeper gap is 2 blocks / 4 s in 21/22 fresh epochs (one 5-block / 10 s outlier). A flash loan cannot span blocks, so the two-tx cycle cannot be atomicized by an unprivileged attacker.

Minimal capital without a flashloan: no protocol minimum (deposit rejects only 0; 1 unit works); gas break-even ~$150 at current rate/gas; meaningful scale $1M-$3.62M of own/collateralized USDSC. No trustless multi-block flash loan exists; a collateralized substitute needs upfront collateral and a USDSC lending market (none found).
caveats: Income-class stream, not a principal drain: the attacker's gross return on dedicated capital is only ~3.3%/yr (3.2-3.4% across windows). It is pure incremental income for an entity that already holds USDSC or can borrow below 3.3%/yr; a fresh buyer must amortise a few hundred to ~$1k round-trip stablecoin slippage on $1M (~1-11 days of epochs).
The $3.5M PoC assumes the attacker can assemble $3.5M of the $4.48M USDSC supply at par; the full-float $333/day figure is an extrapolation. $1M is comfortably available (PoolManager alone $2.25M).
PoC forges the attacker's USDSC balance (equivalent to a secondary-market purchase; totalSupply deliberately unchanged) and does not model DEX price impact or borrow cost.
The M0 yield is claimed in alternating ~$34/~$69 chunks driven by the M index update cadence; the daily rate tracks M0's yield rate and TVL and can change.
sUSDSC ($10,301 TVL, ~$0.12/epoch) has the same class of exposure but is economically negligible and is excluded from the headline.
Post-hoc mitigations exist (Safe pause/blacklist) but do not stop onYield accrual and are bypassed by fresh addresses; no cap/cooldown/timelock exists today.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can capture ~$92/day per $1M (PoC: $7.67 small-epoch + $15.36 large-epoch per $1M), $322/day at $3.5M and ~$333/day at the full $3.62M USDSC float, by depositing one block before the 3-hourly snapshot (nominally HH:00:05) and withdrawing after the distribution (nominally HH:00:09, both within :05-:27); the leak is paid entirely by Startale's remainder bucket and no cap, lock, fee, age gate or harvesting bot exists. Flashloan atomicity is NO: snapshotVaultTVLs() and distribute() are OPERATOR_ROLE-gated (sole member keeper EOA), onYield is RR-only, and MustSnapshotInPreviousBlocks forces a 2-block gap — a real v4 $2M flash loan exists but the atomic cycle reverts at the keeper gate.
